works27Discrepancy.resolution: Live /works SSR renders pageSize=12 initially and loads items 13-27 via Framer CMS client-side pagination/filtering. All 27 project cover thumbnails exist on framerusercontent.com in the decoded Framer CMS chunk mD0yv0kks-chunk-default-0.framercms and all 27/27 covers were downloaded, validated, and optimized into public/assets/images/projects/.
